Ibrahim Khan: Hey all — I’m Ibrahim, starting today on Eng-ML (inference team). Laptop showed up but MDM says ‘enrollment pending’. Who’s the right person for VPN access and MDM enrollment? Also, bagel recs for the office? :wave:
mdm-bot: MDM: enrollment pending for ibrahim.k. To complete, run:
```
/usr/local/bin/mdm-enroll --token REDACTED --user ibrahim.k
```
(This is an automated message — if issues persist, ping Anita Gomez.)
Jess Liu: welcome, @Ibrahim Khan :tada: — @Anita Gomez handles MDM and hardware. For VPN creds, @Samir Patel or I can add you to cloud-jump. If you want a quick ssh jump, use:
```
ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_ibrahim ubuntu@jump.redwood.net
```
Samir Patel: I’ll add you to the infra group now. @Ibrahim Khan do you want oncall pairing in your first week or prefer to shadow? Also if you like sesame bagels the kitchen has some on Thursdays. :bagel:
Anita Gomez: Added a note to the device: remote-wipe disabled, MDM policy applied. You should see the enrollment complete in about 5 min. If not, send me the device serial (or a screenshot). Welcome aboard!
DevX Buddy: Quick tips from onboarding buddies — join #devx for setup walkthroughs, calendar block ‘30m intro’ and we’ll pair on getting your dev env + datasets. Also, coffee + plain bagels = safe choice. :coffee:
Ibrahim Khan: Thanks everyone — enrollment finished and I’m in the VPN. Appreciate the help and the bagel intel :grin:`
